title: The Myth About Mars' Water!

scenes.text: Mars is a barren desert with no water.
Many believe Mars is completely dry and devoid of any water.
scenes.label: Mars is completely dry

scenes.text: In fact, Mars has ice caps and evidence of liquid water flowing in ancient times.
scenes.label: Mars has ancient water

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Mars was once home to water, with evidence indicating ancient rivers. Follow for daily science!
